data.narrative:
Path Robotics, a Series D robotics and manufacturing company founded by Andy and Alex Lonsberry, has raised $271M to date. The valuation analysis considers a comp universe of nine private peers and one public comparable across the robotics and manufacturing sector, with primary focus on five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private companies including Divergent, Exotec, Hadrian, Agile Robots, and Nimble Robotics.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised as a proxy for current value and applying a 1.5x Series D step-up multiplier, implied a valuation of $406M. Peer-median analysis across the five-company comparable set yielded a $1.6B implied valuation, with the peer range spanning $1.0B (Agile Robots, Nimble Robotics at Series C) to $2.3B (Divergent at Series E). The median peer valuation of $1.6B reflects the positioning of same-stage peers Exotec ($2.0B) and Hadrian ($1.6B).

Triangulating these methods produces a valuation range of $346M to $1.8B, with a median of $1.0B. The wide spread reflects uncertainty regarding Path Robotics' relative competitive position and capital efficiency relative to the peer set. The stage-progression method suggests downside; peer-median analysis suggests stronger positioning. Resolution of this gap requires assessment of Path Robotics' revenue traction, unit economics, and market share relative to named comparables.
